law007_recursion_density_ordering_law.name: Recursion Density and Ordering Law
law007_recursion_density_ordering_law.purpose: Define recursion-density ordering across the distributed orientation array.

candidate_law_statement.informal: Local continuation events are ordered by reconciliation structure across the orientation array. Regions of high reconciliation density exhibit tighter update ordering; regions of low reconciliation density exhibit sparser update ordering.
candidate_law_statement.local_reconciliation_event: R_α := admissible update/reconciliation event at locus α
candidate_law_statement.recursion_density_candidate: D_R(U) := (# of admissible reconciliation events in region U) / μ_A(U)
candidate_law_statement.ordering_relation_candidate: R_α ≺ R_β iff R_α is admissibility-preconditioned for R_β under ⇔_R-mediated continuation dependency
candidate_law_statement.apparent_temporality_clause: Apparent time is treated as a projection of ordered reconciliation density, not as a primitive coordinate.
candidate_law_statement.important_note: This law defines candidate ordering structure only; it does not claim physical time dilation, cosmological validation, or global temporal ordering.
